local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = Players[me]:GetUnits():FindID(6) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local x, y = unit:GetX(), unit:GetY()
if x == -9999 then print("ERR:UNIT_CONSUMED"); print("---END---"); return end
local promo = GameInfo.UnitPromotions["PROMOTION_GARRISON"]
if promo == nil then print("ERR:PROMOTION_NOT_FOUND|PROMOTION_GARRISON"); print("---END---"); return end
local exp = unit:GetExperience()
if exp == nil then print("ERR:NO_EXPERIENCE|Unit has no experience object"); print("---END---"); return end
-- XP-threshold gate: prevent infinite promotions from SetPromotion desync.
local ui = GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()]
local promClass = ui and ui.PromotionClass or ""
local xpPromoCount = 0
if promClass ~= "" then
    for p in GameInfo.UnitPromotions() do
        if p.PromotionClass == promClass and exp:HasPromotion(p.Index) then
            xpPromoCount = xpPromoCount + 1
        end
    end
end
local xp = exp:GetExperiencePoints()
local xpNeeded = exp:GetExperienceForNextLevel()
if xp < xpNeeded then print("ERR:INSUFFICIENT_XP|Have " .. xp .. " XP, need " .. xpNeeded .. " for promotion " .. (xpPromoCount + 1) .. " (have " .. xpPromoCount .. " already)"); print("---END---"); return end
local canPromote = false
pcall(function() canPromote = exp:CanPromote(promo.Index) end)
if not canPromote then print("ERR:CANNOT_PROMOTE|Unit cannot receive this promotion (wrong class, missing prereq, or insufficient XP)"); print("---END---"); return end
if exp:HasPromotion(promo.Index) then print("ERR:ALREADY_HAS_PROMOTION|PROMOTION_GARRISON"); print("---END---"); return end
exp:SetPromotion(promo.Index)
if not exp:HasPromotion(promo.Index) then print("ERR:PROMOTION_FAILED|SetPromotion did not apply"); print("---END---"); return end
-- Sync engine state: zero out stored promotions so the engine stops
-- generating ENDTURN_BLOCKING_UNIT_PROMOTION notifications.
-- ChangeStoredPromotions(-1) is insufficient when stored > 1 (e.g. unit
-- earned enough XP for two promotions). Read the current count and zero it.
local stored = 0
pcall(function() stored = exp:GetStoredPromotions() end)
if stored > 0 then
    pcall(function() exp:ChangeStoredPromotions(-stored) end)
end
-- Verify: if stored is still > 0 after zeroing, log it for diagnostics
local storedAfter = 0
pcall(function() storedAfter = exp:GetStoredPromotions() end)
pcall(function() unit:SetDamage(0) end)
local promoName = Locale.Lookup(promo.Name)
print("OK:PROMOTED|" .. promoName .. "|stored:" .. stored .. "->" .. storedAfter)
print("---END---")
